entities.summary: Etsuko Shihomi , born October 29, 1955, in Okayama City, Japan, as Etsuko Shiomi , now known by her married name Etsuko Nagabuchi , is a Japanese actress and martial artist who appeared in several Japanese martial arts films and samurai film and TV productions of the 1970s and 1980s.
